fullContentHtml:
UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released the Answer Key for the UP Police Constable posts after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 32,679 posts. Applications for the UP Police Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 31 December 2025 to 30 January 2026. The examination was held from 08, 09, 10 June 2026. Candidates are advised to regularly check the Sarkari Result portal for updates regarding the UP Police Constable Answer Key 2026, which are uploaded Now.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 31 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 31 December 2025
  • Last Date : 30 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 January 2026
  • Date of Adjustment of Deposited Fee : 02 February 2026
  • Correction Date : 31 January 2026 to 03 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 08, 09 & 10 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 June 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 20 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
